scheme_name: Scholarship/Stipend to SC Students for ITI/Professional Courses (Swami Vivekanand Scholarship)
description:
The Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for SC Students is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scholarship is specifically aimed at providing financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) who are pursuing Industrial Training Institute (ITI) courses or other professional courses. 

The scheme was launched in the year 2013. 

It was introduced with the objective of promoting higher education among SC students. 

The scholarship aims to reduce the financial burden on students and their families. 

It encourages students to pursue vocational and professional education. 

The scheme is named after Swami Vivekanand, a prominent Indian monk and philosopher. 

The scholarship is administered by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure that SC students have access to quality education. 

The government aims to provide financial support to at least 1 lakh SC students annually. 

The scholarship covers various professional courses including engineering, medical, and ITI courses. 

Students can receive a scholarship amount of up to INR 25,000 per annum. 

The exact amount varies depending on the course and institution. 

The scholarship is designed to cover tuition fees, examination fees, and other related expenses. 

Eligible students must belong to the Scheduled Caste category as defined by the Government of India. 

The income limit for the family of the applicant should not exceed INR 2.5 lakh per annum. 

Applicants must be enrolled in recognized ITI or professional courses. 

The age limit for applicants is generally between 18 to 30 years. 

Students must have completed their secondary education (Class 10) to apply for ITI courses. 

For professional courses, students must have completed their higher secondary education (Class 12). 

The application process for the scholarship is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must visit the official website of the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

They need to fill out the online application form available on the portal. 

Applicants must provide personal details including name, address, and contact information. 

They must also upload necessary documents such as caste certificate, income certificate, and educational qualifications. 

The caste certificate must be issued by a competent authority. 

The income certificate should be issued by a government officer. 

After filling out the application form, candidates must submit it online. 

Once submitted, the application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The scholarship amount is disbursed directly to the bank account of the selected candidates. 

The disbursement usually happens on a quarterly basis. 

Candidates can expect to receive the scholarship amount within 2 to 3 months after the application deadline. 

The scholarship is renewable every year based on the academic performance of the student. 

Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in their courses. 

They must also secure at least 50% marks in their examinations to be eligible for renewal. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The department has set up various helplines for students seeking assistance. 

Students can contact the National Scholarship Portal for queries related to the application process. 

The portal provides comprehensive information about the scheme and its benefits. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 500 crore for this scholarship scheme for the financial year 2023-24. 

This funding is aimed at supporting the educational aspirations of SC students. 

The scheme has seen a significant increase in the number of beneficiaries over the years. 

In the year 2022, approximately 1.2 lakh students benefited from this scholarship. 

The government aims to increase this number to 1.5 lakh by the year 2025. 

The scholarship is part of the larger initiative to promote education among marginalized communities. 

It aligns with the government's vision of inclusive growth and development. 

The scheme also emphasizes skill development and vocational training. 

This is crucial for improving employability among SC students. 

The scholarship has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many students have reported improved access to education and training. 

The government regularly reviews and updates the scheme based on feedback. 

The scholarship is a step towards bridging the educational gap in society. 

It plays a vital role in empowering SC students through education. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall economic development of the country. 

By investing in education, the government aims to create a more equitable society. 

The Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for SC Students is a significant initiative. 

It reflects the commitment of the Indian government towards social justice and equality. 

The scheme not only provides financial support but also fosters a sense of confidence among SC students. 

It encourages them to pursue their dreams and aspirations without financial constraints. 

The government continues to promote awareness about the scheme through various outreach programs. 

This ensures that eligible students are informed about the opportunities available to them. 

In conclusion, the Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for SC Students is a comprehensive welfare scheme. 

It provides essential financial support to SC students pursuing vocational and professional courses. 

The scheme is designed to empower students and promote their educational aspirations. 

It is a crucial step towards achieving educational equity in India. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the educational landscape for marginalized communities. 

This scholarship is a testament to that commitment.
